scope: NBHL ball hockey only. Reused assistant-reviewed regression sets; not independent test accuracy.

detection.selection: Maximize development F1, break ties by precision then higher threshold. Freeze prompt and threshold before regression scoring.
detection.filter: No manual rink or role filtering. Officials and spectators count as false positives.

tracking.selection: Native SAM3 defaults, max correct-10*wrong on development, then coverage then fewer unknown joins; person wins exact ties.
tracking.comparison: SAM3 native mask-derived boxes and IDs vs frozen SAM2 plus appearance reconnection. Different observations are an end-to-end comparison, not an association-only ablation.
tracking.occlusion: Empty masks create no observed position. Mask-derived positions may still be hallucinated and need review.

pose.restriction: Visibility labels are not ankle-coordinate ground truth. Report coverage and qualitative errors, not metric accuracy or miles run.

training: None. Pretrained official checkpoints, frozen prompt selection.
